visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with spiky dark hair and a bright red tracksuit jacket stands beside a woman with long dark hair wearing a red knit dress with white button details. They are behind a gray futuristic console in a dark studio featuring green and white neon light strips. The man gestures excitedly while talking to the camera. (2) The scene shifts to a game show set where the man and woman sit at small pink wooden desks. They hold small blackboards with handwritten Chinese characters. A male host in a dark suit stands in the center near a large game screen, and another woman in red holds a giant yellow die. (3) The man is seen standing in front of a board decorated with dozens of red envelopes. He pulls one off and displays a stack of banknotes to the camera with a triumphant expression. The woman in red and other staff members stand around him, clapping. (4) The man sits at a blue digital desk in a different game segment. A large split screen behind him shows 'A' and 'B' options with historical portraits. He looks intensely focused on the screen, then relaxes and smiles as a 'Correct' checkmark graphic appears over option B.
